Kerala Assembly faces controversy over low-alcohol beverage tax cut

The Kerala Assembly has seen controversy surrounding a tax cut on low-alcohol beverages. Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan has accused the ruling UDF of haste and favouring liquor companies, while the government maintains the tax cut does not signify approval for sale. The move has also drawn opposition from religious bodies like the Latin Catholic Church.
